title: Building a robot mission based on mission metrics
publicly_described_functional_concepts: repository of previously recorded robot missions
context metadata associated with tasks and facilities
mission ranking using recorded performance or quality metrics
confidence or ranking information used to select a mission
design_divergence_defaults: separate patent evidence retrieval from runtime control
use an explicit compliance and safety gate before mission activation
require operator approval before executing a generated mission
use independently defined multi-objective scoring rather than copying claim wording or claimed scoring sequence
use vendor/device adapters only after a robot-independent task contract has passed safety review
maintain provenance showing which patent concepts informed each design decision

mandatory_safety_boundaries: emergency-stop or equivalent risk control where physical motion can create hazards
signed or authenticated software update path
audit log of mission approval and execution
